name: TD6S
description: The TriangleLab TCHC TD6S is an all-metal hotend featuring a ceramic heating core and the TUN (TriangleLab Unity Nozzle) system where the heatbreak and nozzle are integrated into a single one-piece component to prevent leaks. It uses V6-compatible M6 threading and a V6 groove mount interface. The ceramic heating ring provides fast, even heat distribution.

nozzleSpecs.system: TUN (TriangleLab Unity Nozzle, M6 V6-compatible thread, integrated heatbreak+nozzle)
compatibleNozzles: TriangleLab thin-wall bi-metal heatbreak with V6 nozzles

features: Ceramic heating core for fast even heating
V6 groove mount for broad printer compatibility
Compatible with all V6 hotend interfaces
